paragraphs.notes: PROVENANCE NOTE FOR THIS WHOLE PAGE - read this before using any zh field. CN109678767A is born digital: every page carries a real embedded text layer, and the zh fields on this page were EXTRACTED from that text layer (the publication's own character codes), not transcribed from pixels by a model. Each extracted string was then checked against the rendered page image at 3x to 5x magnification and matched character for character. The drawings are the only content that the text layer cannot hold; those were read off the image and are the only model-read content on this page. TRANSCRIPTION CONVENTIONS applied uniformly across the page: (1) The publication hard-wraps each paragraph across several printed lines. Those line breaks are typesetting, not content, and the wrapped lines have been joined with no separator inserted. (2) The CNIPA typesetting letterspaces every Latin/digit run uniformly. In paragraph [0089] only, the PDF text extractor emitted word spaces where that letterspacing exceeded its threshold, yielding '34 .6g(0 .1mol)' and '(2 ,2 ,2-'. Checked at 5x magnification, the printed page shows NO word space at any of those points - the letterspacing there is identical to '13.1g(0.05mol)' in [0083], where the extractor emitted no space. Those spaces are extraction artifacts and have NOT been reproduced; the raw extractor output for [0089] is quoted verbatim in that paragraph's own notes so nothing is lost. No other whitespace was altered anywhere on the page. (3) Punctuation width is taken from the text layer, which is authoritative for character identity: full-width '，' '、' '。' '；' '％' '＝' in prose, half-width '(' ')' ',' '.' inside Latin/digit and locant runs, and U+2103 '℃' for degrees Celsius. Because the font letterspaces Latin runs, parenthesis width cannot be judged reliably from the image alone; the text layer settles it. Nothing has been normalised, corrected or 'fixed' - printed typos are carried through verbatim and flagged in discrepancies. STRUCTURAL NOTE ON THIS MARKER: [0082] is printed at the left margin with no text; it is the slot occupied by the first drawing on the page (see drawings[0]). The same is true of [0085] and [0088]. ROUTE ATTRIBUTION: this page continues the 对比实施例 (Comparative Example) that opens at [0080] on page 10 - see each drawing's notes.

paragraphs.zh: 称取13.1g(0.05mol)2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯于500mL四口烧瓶中，加入180mL四氯化碳，升温回流，滴加8.8g(0.055mol)溴素，保温反应4h，停止反应，冷却、过滤，滤液浓缩得淡黄色固体15g，收率88％。
paragraphs.en: 13.1 g (0.05 mol) of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate was weighed into a 500 mL four-necked flask, 180 mL of carbon tetrachloride was added, the temperature was raised to reflux, 8.8 g (0.055 mol) of bromine was added dropwise, the reaction was held at temperature for 4 h, the reaction was stopped, cooled and filtered; the filtrate was concentrated to give 15 g of a pale yellow solid, yield 88%.
paragraphs.notes: This is step 1 of the Comparative Example, whose heading 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成 is printed as [0081] at the foot of page 10; the heading is NOT on this page. 溴素 = elemental bromine (Br2). All quantities are internally consistent: substrate C10H11ClO4S MW 262.7, so 13.1 g = 0.0499 mol, matching the printed 0.05 mol; Br2 MW 159.8, so 8.8 g = 0.055 mol, matching; the product drawn at [0082] is C10H10BrClO4S MW 341.6, so 15 g = 0.0439 mol, which is 87.8% of 0.05 mol and matches the printed 88％. NO radical initiator (no AIBN, no benzoyl peroxide) and no light source is named anywhere in this paragraph, although the drawing at [0082] shows benzylic bromination; recorded in discrepancies, not inferred into the text. Contrast the Example on page 10, which brominates with 氢溴酸/双氧水 under AIBN. Reaction temperature is given only as 回流 (reflux) with no figure; the CCl4 solvent fixes it near 77 ℃ but no number is printed and none has been added.

paragraphs.zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step heading for step 2 of the Comparative Example. The step number 2 is followed by the enumeration mark '、' as printed, not by a parenthesis. Parentheses around 2,2,2-三氟乙氧基 are half-width in the text layer, and the locant commas inside are half-width, both reproduced as extracted. This heading names the step-2 product as the free ACID (苯甲酸), which agrees with the structure drawn at [0085] and with the acidification described at the end of [0086]. The identical heading appears as [0074] on page 10 for the corresponding step of the Example.
Marker printed at the left margin with no text; it is the slot occupied by the second drawing on the page (see drawings[1]).

paragraphs.zh: 将5.4g(0.1mol)甲醇钠称于120mLDMF中，加入四口烧瓶中，冷却至15℃，滴加三氟乙醇，滴毕后，加入2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯，室温下反应过夜，蒸出DMF，冷却后加入100mL乙醇，滴加10％NaOH溶液40mL，滴毕后回流1h，反应完毕，蒸出乙醇，用HCL调至酸性，黄色固体析出，收率为83.2％。
paragraphs.en: 5.4 g (0.1 mol) of sodium methoxide was weighed into 120 mL of DMF and charged to a four-necked flask, cooled to 15 ℃, and trifluoroethanol was added dropwise. After the addition was complete, methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate was added and the mixture was reacted overnight at room temperature; DMF was distilled off, and after cooling 100 mL of ethanol was added and 40 mL of 10% NaOH solution was added dropwise; after the addition was complete the mixture was refluxed for 1 h. The reaction being complete, the ethanol was distilled off, the mixture was adjusted to acidity with HCL, and a yellow solid precipitated; the yield was 83.2%.
paragraphs.notes: Step 2 of the Comparative Example. QUANTITY GAPS that block any mass balance on this step: no quantity is given for 三氟乙醇 (trifluoroethanol, added only 滴加 dropwise), none for the substrate 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯, no product mass, and no product name in the prose - only the yield figure 83.2％. The identity of the product comes from the heading [0084] and from the structure drawn at [0085], not from this paragraph. 甲醇钠 = sodium methoxide, MW 54.02, so 5.4 g = 0.1 mol, internally consistent; it deprotonates the trifluoroethanol in situ to give the trifluoroethoxide nucleophile. 'HCL' is printed with a capital L, not 'HCl'; reproduced verbatim and flagged. '15℃' uses the single glyph U+2103. '120mLDMF' is printed with no space between the volume and the solvent name, as extracted. Compare the corresponding Example step [0076] on page 10, which uses K2CO3 / triethylenediamine / DMF and avoids sodium methoxide entirely - the avoidance that [0090] claims as the point of the invention.

环磺酮 is the Chinese common name for tembotrione. The identification is not taken on trust from the name: the structure drawn at [0088] is read independently off the image and is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.8, which is tembotrione. Note this patent writes 环磺酮 throughout, whereas the reference patent CN104292137A writes 环磺草酮 for the same compound; recorded so a downstream name-matching pass does not treat them as different targets. The identical heading appears as [0077] on page 10 for the corresponding step of the Example.
Marker printed at the left margin with no text; it is the slot occupied by the third drawing on the page (see drawings[2]).

paragraphs.zh: 将34.6g(0.1mol)2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸溶于200ml中二氯甲烷，滴加60g(0.5mol)的氯化亚砜，回流反应5h，然后整出溶剂和过量的氯化亚砜，残液加入150ml乙腈溶解，然后加入13.44g(0.12mol)1,3-环己二酮和4滴丙酮氰醇。室温搅拌16h。过滤，滤液浓缩，加入150ml水，用2mol/L盐酸调至PH＝2后，过滤、干燥，得黄色固体35g。收率为80％。
paragraphs.en: 34.6 g (0.1 mol) of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid was dissolved in 200 ml of dichloromethane, 60 g (0.5 mol) of thionyl chloride was added dropwise and the mixture was refluxed for 5 h; the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride were then 整出 (as printed, evidently a misprint for 蒸出, 'distilled off'), 150 ml of acetonitrile was added to the residual liquid to dissolve it, and then 13.44 g (0.12 mol) of 1,3-cyclohexanedione and 4 drops of acetone cyanohydrin were added. Stirred at room temperature for 16 h. Filtered; the filtrate was concentrated, 150 ml of water was added, the mixture was adjusted to PH＝2 with 2 mol/L hydrochloric acid, then filtered and dried to give 35 g of a yellow solid. The yield was 80%.
paragraphs.notes: Step 3 of the Comparative Example. RAW EXTRACTOR OUTPUT, quoted verbatim so the artifact spacing is not lost: '将34 .6g(0 .1mol)2-氯-3-(2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸溶于' and '得黄' / '色固体35g。'. The word spaces in '34 .6g', '(0 .1mol)' and '(2 ,2 ,2-' appear in the extractor output only; at 5x magnification the printed page shows no space at any of those points, and the same extractor emitted no space in the visually identical '13.1g(0.05mol)' of [0083]. They are extraction artifacts and were not reproduced in zh. TWO PRINTED ERRORS carried through verbatim and flagged in discrepancies: 整出 where 蒸出 (distil off) is meant, and the misplaced 中 in 溶于200ml中二氯甲烷 (printed as 'dissolved in 200 ml, in dichloromethane'; the normal order would be 200ml二氯甲烷中). Quantities are internally consistent: acid C11H10ClF3O5S MW 346.7, so 34.6 g = 0.0998 mol matching 0.1 mol; SOCl2 MW 118.97, so 60 g = 0.504 mol matching 0.5 mol; 1,3-cyclohexanedione MW 112.13, so 13.44 g = 0.1198 mol matching 0.12 mol; product C17H16ClF3O6S MW 440.8, so 35 g = 0.0794 mol, which is 79.4% of 0.1 mol and matches the printed 80％. Acetone cyanohydrin is quantified as 4滴 (4 drops), a volume that cannot be converted to moles, so the catalyst loading is unusable for mass balance. NO BASE is named in this step - no triethylamine, no carbonate - although the corresponding Example step [0079] on page 10 uses 30.6 g of triethylamine; recorded in discrepancies. 'PH＝2' uses a full-width '＝' and prints PH rather than pH, as extracted. 'ml' is lower case here throughout, where [0083] and [0086] use 'mL'; reproduced as printed. No temperature figure is given for the reflux.

paragraphs.zh: 通过实施例与对比例比较可知，在制备环磺酮过程中使用氢溴酸代替溴素作为溴化剂，避免使用乙腈，甲醇钠等危险化学品，本专利的核心是使用低毒性、低危险性化学品制备环磺酮，降低了生产过程中危险因素、慢性中毒等因素；同时通过实验实施发现能够取得较高的收率也是意料之外的。
paragraphs.en: From the comparison of the Example with the Comparative Example it can be seen that, in the course of preparing tembotrione, using hydrobromic acid in place of bromine as the brominating agent avoids the use of hazardous chemicals such as acetonitrile and sodium methoxide. The core of this patent is the use of low-toxicity, low-hazard chemicals to prepare tembotrione, which reduces hazard factors, chronic poisoning and similar factors in the production process; at the same time it was found through experimental implementation that a comparatively high yield could also be obtained, which was unexpected.
paragraphs.notes: Closing paragraph of the description and the last text on the last page. It is the paragraph that settles the attribution of everything above it on this page: it contrasts 实施例 (the Example, pages 9 to 10) with 对比例 (the Comparative Example, [0080] to [0089]), and the three reagents it names as the ones being avoided - 溴素 (bromine), 乙腈 (acetonitrile) and 甲醇钠 (sodium methoxide) - are exactly the three that [0083], [0089] and [0086] respectively use. So the route drawn and described on this page is the one the patent argues AGAINST, not the invention's route. Note the paragraph uses the short form 对比例 whereas the heading at [0080] on page 10 prints 对比实施例; both are reproduced as printed in their own places. 氢溴酸 = hydrobromic acid, the substitute reagent used in the Example at [0073] on page 10. The claim of higher yield is asserted, not tabulated: no comparison table appears anywhere in the description.

structures.name: methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrow and no reagent text anywhere in the drawing. Read at 3x magnification: every atom label (O, H3CO, Cl, Br, O, S, O, CH3) is crisply printed and the ring is drawn as a plain Kekule hexagon with three internal double bonds. The four substituents sit on four CONSECUTIVE ring vertices, read directly off the drawing: the ester-bearing vertex, then clockwise the Cl vertex, then the CH2Br vertex, then the SO2CH3 vertex. Numbering the ester carbon C1 gives 2-Cl, 3-CH2Br, 4-SO2CH3, which is how the substituents are recorded above. ROUTE ATTRIBUTION, as required: this is NOT the invention's route. It is the product of step 1 of the 对比实施例 (Comparative Example) that begins at [0080] on page 10, i.e. the comparison route the patent runs in order to argue against it; [0090] on this page confirms that reading. It is not labelled prior art either, so presented_as is recorded as intermediate_structure rather than forcing it into the prior_art bucket. The same compound is an intermediate of the invention's own Example too, made there by a different bromination; the STRUCTURE is common to both routes, the STEP shown here is the comparative one. Molecular formula of the structure as drawn is C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.6, which matches the 15 g / 88％ figures in [0083].

structures.name: 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrow and no reagent text. Read at 3x magnification. The trifluoroethoxymethyl arm is printed as one condensed label 'CH2OCH2CF3' with subscript 2, 2 and 3, not as a skeletal chain, so its connectivity is read from the label text rather than from bonds: ring-CH2-O-CH2-CF3. The subscripts are legible without ambiguity at 3x. Substituents again occupy four consecutive vertices; numbering the carboxyl carbon C1 gives 2-Cl, 3-CH2OCH2CF3, 4-SO2CH3. The carboxyl is drawn as the free acid (HO, not an ester alkyl), which agrees with the heading at [0084] and with the acidification at the end of [0086]. ROUTE ATTRIBUTION: NOT the invention's route - this is the product of step 2 of the 对比实施例 (Comparative Example) opened at [0080] on page 10; see [0090]. Molecular formula as drawn is C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.7, which matches the 34.6 g / 0.1 mol charge in [0089] where this compound is the substrate of the next step.

substituents: on the cyclohexanedione ring: =O at C1 and =O at C3, both drawn as exocyclic double-bonded O; the ring is drawn fully saturated with no enol OH and no ring double bond
on the cyclohexanedione ring: aroyl group at C2, drawn as a single bond from C2 to a carbon bearing a double-bonded O, which in turn bonds to the benzene ring
on the benzene ring: C(=O) linkage to the diketone at C1
on the benzene ring: Cl at C2
on the benzene ring: CH2OCH2CF3 at C3, drawn as a bond to the condensed label CH2OCH2CF3
on the benzene ring: SO2CH3 at C4, drawn as S with two double-bonded O and a CH3 label
structures.name: 2-{2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione)

drawings.notes: Single structure, no arrow and no reagent text. Read at 2x and again at higher magnification on the diketone ring specifically, because the tautomer matters: the ring is drawn in the DIKETO form as a plain saturated hexagon with two exocyclic C=O and an sp3 C2 bearing the aroyl group. There is no OH label, no ring double bond and no enol drawn anywhere. That is recorded as drawn; the compound is commonly depicted in the enol form elsewhere, but nothing on this page supports substituting it. The C-acyl connectivity (aroyl on ring carbon C2) is read off the bonds, not inferred from what the product 'should' be; note that [0089] describes acid chloride plus 1,3-cyclohexanedione plus acetone cyanohydrin, a sequence that proceeds through the O-acyl enol ester before rearranging to this C-acyl product, and the prose never states which of the two the 35 g of yellow solid is. The drawing settles it as the C-acyl compound. Benzene substituents occupy four consecutive vertices as in the other two drawings: aroyl C1, Cl C2, CH2OCH2CF3 C3, SO2CH3 C4. Molecular formula as drawn is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.8, which is tembotrione and matches the 35 g / 80％ figures in [0089] and the 环磺酮 heading at [0087]. ROUTE ATTRIBUTION: NOT the invention's route - this is the final product of the 对比实施例 (Comparative Example) opened at [0080] on page 10, drawn here to close the comparison; the invention's own Example makes the same target on pages 9 to 10. presented_as is recorded as intermediate_structure because that is the enum value for a standalone drawn structure; it is in fact the FINAL TARGET of the comparative route, not an intermediate, and is recorded as such here rather than being forced into invention_route or prior_art.

discrepancies.what: Whole-page attribution. Every structure and every step on this page belongs to the Comparative Example, not to the invention. Downstream passes that pick up the drawings without this context will read the patent's counter-example as its route.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Three product structures are drawn with no caption or label of any kind identifying which route they belong to. Nothing inside any drawing distinguishes them from the invention's own intermediates, which are the same three compounds.
discrepancies.text_says: The heading 对比实施例 (Comparative Example) is printed as [0080] on PAGE 10, one page earlier, and the step-1 heading as [0081]. Neither is repeated on this page. [0090] on this page confirms the attribution from the other direction: it names 溴素, 乙腈 and 甲醇钠 as the hazardous reagents the invention avoids, and those are exactly the reagents used by [0083], [0089] and [0086] here.

discrepancies.what: The drawing shows a benzylic bromination product, but the prose for that step names no radical initiator and no light source.
discrepancies.drawing_says: [0082] shows CH2Br on the ring carbon that carried CH3 in the substrate, i.e. benzylic substitution rather than ring bromination.
discrepancies.text_says: [0083] gives only 溴素 (Br2), 四氯化碳 (CCl4) and 升温回流 (heat to reflux). No AIBN, no benzoyl peroxide, no peroxide of any kind and no irradiation is mentioned. The invention's own corresponding step [0073] on page 10 does use AIBN. Recorded as printed; no initiator has been inferred into the transcription.

discrepancies.what: Printed typo carried through verbatim: 整出 where 蒸出 (distil off) is meant.
discrepancies.text_says: [0089] reads 然后整出溶剂和过量的氯化亚砜. 整 (zheng, 'to arrange') makes no sense with 溶剂; 蒸出 ('distil off') is plainly intended, and the very same paragraph set uses 蒸出 correctly twice in [0086] (蒸出DMF, 蒸出乙醇). Both the embedded text layer and the rendered image agree on 整, so this is the publication's own error, not an extraction fault. Transcribed verbatim and translated with the misprint marked in place.

discrepancies.what: Printed word-order error carried through verbatim: the locative 中 is misplaced in the solvent phrase.
discrepancies.text_says: [0089] reads 溶于200ml中二氯甲烷, literally 'dissolved in 200 ml, in dichloromethane'. Standard order would be 溶于200ml二氯甲烷中. The meaning is not in doubt - 200 ml of dichloromethane - but the characters are reproduced as printed.

discrepancies.what: Printed capitalisation error carried through verbatim: HCL for HCl.
discrepancies.text_says: [0086] reads 用HCL调至酸性 with a capital L. Elsewhere the description writes 盐酸 in Chinese ([0089]) rather than a formula, so there is no competing spelling on this page. Reproduced as printed.

discrepancies.what: The prose for step 2 identifies its product neither by name nor by mass; only the drawing supplies the identity, and no mass balance is possible for that step.
discrepancies.drawing_says: [0085] draws the product as 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoic acid, the free acid.
discrepancies.text_says: [0086] ends 黄色固体析出，收率为83.2％ - 'a yellow solid precipitated, the yield was 83.2％'. No product name, no product mass, no substrate quantity and no trifluoroethanol quantity are given anywhere in the paragraph, so the 83.2％ cannot be checked against anything. The heading [0084] does name the acid, which agrees with the drawing.

discrepancies.what: The final coupling step names no base, unlike the corresponding step of the invention's Example.
discrepancies.drawing_says: [0088] draws the C-acylated 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione, the product of the acylation plus rearrangement sequence.
discrepancies.text_says: [0089] charges only the acid chloride solution, 150 ml acetonitrile, 13.44 g 1,3-cyclohexanedione and 4 drops of acetone cyanohydrin. No triethylamine and no other base appears, where the Example's corresponding step [0079] on page 10 adds 30.6 g of triethylamine before the acetone cyanohydrin. Recorded as printed; no base has been inferred.

discrepancies.what: The catalyst in the final step is quantified as a drop count, which cannot be converted to moles.
discrepancies.text_says: [0089] reads 4滴丙酮氰醇 - '4 drops of acetone cyanohydrin'. Every other reagent in that paragraph carries both a mass and a molar figure. A downstream mass-balance pass must treat this loading as unquantified rather than estimating a drop volume.

discrepancies.what: Unit and name-form inconsistencies within the page that downstream passes should not read as meaningful.
discrepancies.text_says: Volume units are printed 'mL' in [0083] and [0086] but 'ml' in [0089]. [0089] prints 'PH＝2' with a full-width '＝' and an upper-case P-H rather than 'pH'. This patent writes the target as 环磺酮 throughout, whereas the reference patent CN104292137A writes 环磺草酮 for the same compound. [0090] shortens 对比实施例 (as headed at [0080] on page 10) to 对比例. All reproduced as printed.
